title: Which Fictional Genre Is Your Soulmate?
description: Discover which literary genre matches your personality perfectly!

questions.question: How do you prefer to spend a perfect weekend?

options.text: Exploring new places and having adventures
Getting lost in a gripping story
Cozy day in with comfort reads

questions.question: What kind of movie plot excites you the most?

options.text: Epic battle between good and evil
Heartwarming story of love and connection

questions.question: Which quote resonates with you most?

options.text: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity
The truth will set you free
Imagination is more important than knowledge

questions.question: What do you value most in a story?

options.text: Suspense and keeping me on edge

questions.question: How do you handle challenges in real life?

options.text: Rely on my support system and loved ones

questions.question: What's your favorite type of music to read to?
If you could have any superpower, what would it be?
What kind of friend do you tend to be?

options.text: The one who always has dramatic stories
The imaginative dreamer with wild ideas

questions.question: What's your approach to making decisions?

romance.title: Romance
romance.description: You are a hopeless romantic at heart! You crave emotional connections, heartfelt moments, and stories that celebrate love in all its forms. Your soulmate genre is Romance - where love conquers all and happy endings are guaranteed.

fantasy.title: Fantasy
fantasy.description: You dream of magical worlds and epic adventures! Your imagination knows no bounds, and you love stories where anything is possible. Your soulmate genre is Fantasy - where heroes rise, magic exists, and legends are made.

mystery.title: Mystery
mystery.description: You have an investigative mind that loves solving puzzles! You thrive on clues, red herrings, and the satisfaction of uncovering the truth. Your soulmate genre is Mystery - where every question has an answer waiting to be found.

thriller.title: Thriller
thriller.description: You live for adrenaline and suspense! You love stories that keep you on the edge of your seat, wondering what happens next. Your soulmate genre is Thriller - where the stakes are high and tension never ends.

scifi.title: Science Fiction
scifi.description: You're fascinated by the future and what lies beyond the stars! You love exploring 'what if' scenarios and innovative ideas. Your soulmate genre is Science Fiction - where technology meets imagination and possibilities are endless.

contemporary.title: Contemporary Fiction
contemporary.description: You appreciate relatable stories that reflect real life! You enjoy narratives with well-developed characters facing everyday challenges. Your soulmate genre is Contemporary Fiction - where slice-of-life meets emotional depth.

historical.title: Historical Fiction
historical.description: You're drawn to the past and its stories! You love experiencing different eras and learning about history through compelling narratives. Your soulmate genre is Historical Fiction - where the past comes alive with drama and intrigue.

action.title: Action & Adventure
action.description: You're always ready for excitement and adventure! You love fast-paced stories with high energy and non-stop action. Your soulmate genre is Action & Adventure - where heroes act first and ask questions later.
